document_metadata.title: 1、INT. HIGH SCHOOL CLASSROOM - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Starla Grant teaches evolution, comparing human and cockroach longevity, sparks debate on religion and science; class ends with a bell, leaving a question unresolved as students depart.

entities.name: Starla Grant explains Darwin's meaning of 'fittest'
entities.description: Starla Grant verbally clarifies to her students that Darwin's concept of 'fittest' refers to organisms best suited to their environment, not merely the strongest or most intelligent.

entities.name: Grant discovers shimmering particles flowing in the creek
entities.description: While sitting beside a creek, Grant notices strange particles moving downstream, shimmering in the moonlight, which prompts him to investigate further.

entities.name: Spore launches and embeds itself in Grant's abdomen
entities.description: The spore suddenly shoots forward, striking Grant in the stomach and burrowing into his body, causing immediate pain and visible penetration.

entities.name: Grant reacts to abdominal wound and screams in agony
entities.description: After the spore enters his body, Grant pulls up his shirt to see the injury, clutches his stomach, and collapses backward into the flowers while convulsing in pain.

document_metadata.summary: Bill kills the doe attacking him and shoots the deer dragging Trevor; more diseased deer approach as Starla arrives, urging everyone to get in the car.

entities.name: Starla starts the Buick's engine while being pulled by a horned buck
entities.description: While caught between the horned buck pulling on her ankle and her grip on the steering wheel, Starla flips onto her side and successfully turns the keys in the ignition, starting the engine.

entities.name: Starla accelerates the Buick to escape the horned buck
entities.description: After starting the engine, Starla reaches down to press the gas pedal, causing the car to lurch forward and wrench her free from the buck's grasp.

entities.description: Bill attempts to grab the barrel of his rifle during the attack, but it is out of reach.

entities.name: Bill uses the rifle as a club to strike the attacking deer
entities.description: Grasping the rifle by the muzzle, Bill swings it like a baseball bat and hits the deer jumping on him in the face, knocking it back.

entities.name: The deer collapses and dies from head trauma
entities.description: After being struck by Bill, the deer attempts to advance again but stumbles as its head and neck are misaligned, ultimately toppling over dead.
